text:
The viscera involved is the colon, most likely from irritable bowel syndrome with mixed bowel habits. Its sympathetic fibers originate from preganglionic neurons in the intermediolateral cell column of the thoracolumbar spinal cord (about T10–L2), then travel via the thoracic and lumbar splanchnic nerves to synapse in the superior and inferior mesenteric ganglia.
CONFIDENCE: 70
